answer: Farming becomes a trellis bet on surviving 98 epochs of grading, and every ocean settlement recomputes the voyage schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 18 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 98 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 35 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
